title: Update Agent SDK for Cutover MCP Tools
description: Update the ForgeOS Agent SDK (Python) to add client wrappers for the 3 new cutover MCP tools: tickets.get, tickets.list, tickets.payload. Add Pydantic models for ticket, payload, and list response types. This allows agents to call the new tools via the SDK.
acceptance_criteria: Pydantic models: Ticket, TicketPayload, TicketListResponse match MCP schemas
Error handling follows existing SDK patterns (raises typed exceptions)
Unit tests for each new method with mocked MCP responses
README updated with cutover tool usage examples
